collection.title: VIIRS/NPP Gross Primary Productivity and Net Photosynthesis 8-Day L4 Global 500m SIN Grid V002
collection.summary: The delivery of all Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership (Suomi NPP) VIIRS science data products [ceased on November 2, 2026 (2026/306)](https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/alerts-outages/reminder-new-suomi-npp-observations-cease-november-2-2026). Data users are encouraged to transition to the equivalent [VJ217A2](https://doi.org/10.5067/VIIRS/VJ217A2.002) (primary) or [VJ117A2](https://doi.org/10.5067/VIIRS/VJ117A2.002) (secondary) data products. The NASA/NOAA Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership (Suomi NPP) Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) and Net Photosynthesis (PSN) (VNP17A2) Version 2 data product is a cumulative composite of GPP values based on the radiation use efficiency concept that is potentially used as inputs to data models to calculate terrestrial energy, carbon, water cycle processes, and biogeochemistry of vegetation. VNP17A2 is an 8-day composite at 500 meter (m) spatial resolution delivered as a gridded Level 4 (L4) product in Sinusoidal projection. Provided in the VNP17A2 product are 3 variables for GPP, PSN, along with a quality control variable. A low resolution browse image for GPP is also available for each VNP17A2 granule. Known Issues * For complete information about known issues please refer to the [MODIS/VIIRS Land Quality Assessment website](https://landweb.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/knownissue?sensor=VIIRS).

documentation.description: The LDOPE Land Product Quality Assessment website provides known issues, maneuvers, and product quality of the land products.
The technical information in the User's Guide enables users to interpret and use the data products.
Further details regarding VIIRS product validation and maturity status are available from VIIRS Land Product Quality Assessment site.
